name: Can a flexible listing agreement be used for commercial properties in Miami-Dade County?

mainEntity.name: Can a flexible listing agreement be used for commercial properties in Miami-Dade County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, flexible listing agreements can be applied to commercial properties, including those in Miami-Dade County, although they are more commonly seen with residential sales. The principles remain the same: the seller retains the right to sell the property themselves without owing a commission to the agent. However, commercial real estate transactions often involve more complex due diligence and a specialized buyer pool. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution has experience navigating both residential and commercial markets across our service areas, and we can discuss the specific implications of using a flexible agreement for your commercial property in Miami-Dade.
